content.text:
An analysis of the examples reveals the following rule:

1. Identify the hollow diamond outline (a diamond/rhombus shape with an empty/unfilled interior).
2. Fill its interior with the same color as the outline, making it a solid diamond.
3. Leave all other shapes (solid diamonds, rectangles, etc.) unchanged.

Please provide the test input grid to transform.
